preconditions.description: The number of queries is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The number of nodes in each graph is between 2 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of edges in each graph is between 1 and half the number of possible edges, inclusive.
Each node number in the graph is between 1 and the number of nodes, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each edge (u, v) is represented only once
preconditions.description: Each undirected edge is represented by a pair of directed edges (u, v) and (v, u).

postconditions.description: The output contains one entry for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(len(distances) == n - 1 for distances in output)
postconditions.description: Each entry in the output contains n-1 distances, not including the starting node.

postconditions.expression: all(distances[i - s - 1] == 6 * (i - 1) if i in reachable_nodes else distances[i - s - 1] == -1 for i in range(1, n + 1) if i != s)
postconditions.description: For each reachable node, the distance is 6 times the number of edges from the start node. For unreachable nodes, the distance is -1.

postconditions.expression: all(distances[i - s - 1] == -1 for i in range(1, n + 1) if i not in reachable_nodes)
postconditions.description: For each unreachable node, the distance is -1.

invariants.description: The set of reachable nodes is a subset of the set of all nodes.
